Name: Aarohan – Musical Fundraiser
Short Description: A musical fundraiser to support underprivileged children in need of critical medical care.
Full Description: The event raised funds for pediatric heart surgeries, thalassemia treatment, dental care, and other medical disorders. Through the power of music, we aimed to create a positive impact on the lives of these children.

Name: Empowering Young Minds
Short Description: Equipping underprivileged children with essential school supplies and support to succeed.
Full Description: Our distribution drive aims to provide essential school supplies and support to government school students, fostering a brighter future for every child.

Name: Say No to Plastic
Short Description: Promoting a greener future by eliminating plastic bags in our community.
Full Description: Rotary Bangalore JP Nagar distributed eco-friendly bags in the vicinity of RV Dental College to encourage the community to adopt sustainable practices.

Name: Government School – Nelehal
Short Description: Groundbreaking ceremony for a new government school at Nelehal with CSR Tmeic.
Full Description: On July 1st, 2024, Rotary Bangalore JP Nagar, in partnership with CSR Tmeic, conducted a groundbreaking ceremony for the new Government School at Nelehal near Tumkur, marking the beginning of a significant educational initiative.

Name: Dialysis Machine – CDSIMER
Short Description: Inauguration of new dialysis machines at CDSIMER, improving healthcare access.
Full Description: Rotary Bangalore JP Nagar inaugurated new dialysis machines at CDSIMER, marking a significant step in improving healthcare facilities in the area for patients with renal conditions.

Name: School Fee Donation
Short Description: A generous donation for the school fee of a girl child, supporting her education.
Full Description: Past Presidents Rtn. Devraj and Rtn. Basavaraj Haldal generously donated Rs. 53,000 towards the school fee of a girl child, highlighting their commitment to empowering young girls in our community.
